reason: The frozen fixture incorrectly classified the two deterministic audit exercises as business jobs and used expected business outcomes. The governing Loop 3 contract requires these protected exercises to remain test_fixture jobs and prohibits them from writing BusinessOutcome.
accepted_changes: Classify every protected Loop 3 exercise as job_kind=test_fixture.
Express deterministic simulation expectations as fixture_result and expected_status.
Keep business_outcome null for every protected fixture item.
scope_effect: This correction narrows the fixture to the already-authorized test boundary. It does not add a business module, production data, real platform access, or a platform write capability.
